1.

Petitioner is before this Court under Section 439(1)(b) of Cr.P.C. with a prayer to relax Condition No.6 imposed by the Court of Principal Senior Civil Judge and C.J.M., Haveri in C.C.No.125 of 2019 by the order dated 08.04.2025, wherein the application filed by the petitioner under Section 437 of Cr.P.C. seeking regular bail was allowed.

entities.text: Principal Senior Civil Judge and C.J.M., Haveri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned HCGP who is directed to take notice for the respondent.
3.

Petitioner who is arrayed as accused No.1 in the present case has been charge sheeted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

4. Petitioner had filed regular bail application under Section 437 of Cr.P.C. before the Jurisdictional Magistrate, which was allowed by the order dated NC: 2025:KHC-D:9738 HC-KAR 08.04.2025 subject to certain conditions.

Condition No.6 imposed by the learned Magistrate reads as follows:
"The petitioner/accused No.1 shall deposit the amount of maintenance filed by the CW-1 of recovery petition in Crl.Misc.No.114/2021, 155/2022, 153/2023, 174/2024 in total Rs.7,00,000/-."
5.
With a prayer to relax the said condition, the petitioner is before this Court.

6. The Condition No.6 imposed by the trial Court directs the petitioner to pay the maintenance amount awarded in Crl.Misc.No.114 of 2021, 155 of 2022, 153 of 2023 and 174 of 2024, which totally amounts to Rs.7,00,000/-.
Such a condition cannot be imposed by the Court while granting bail to the accused.

The Hon'ble Supreme Court as well as this Court time and again have stated that such Shri. Iranna S/O. Ningappa Belliwali vs The State Of Karnataka on 5 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17451162/

Accordingly, the following:
NC: 2025:KHC-D:9738 HC-KAR ORDER i. Criminal Petition is allowed.
ii . Condition No.6 imposed by the Court of Principal Senior Civil Judge and C.J.M., Haveri in C.C.No.125 of 2019 by order dated 08.04.2025 stands relaxed.
iii. All other conditions imposed by the trial Court stands unaltered.

Sd/-
(S.VISHWAJITH SHETTY) JUDGE KGK CT:BCK Shri.
